package planted

// A planted instance of the #1901 defect class, kept as the class guard's positive control:
// an own-PR check written as a bare branch-NAME compare instead of deskkit.CheckOwnPR.
// TestOwnPRClassGuard must flag the line below; if it ever stops doing so the guard's
// matcher is broken and would report the real tree clean for the wrong reason.

type view struct{ HeadRefName string }

func mine(v view, branch string) bool {
	return v.HeadRefName == branch
}
